scene: A cyan figure gestures with an open palm toward a magenta figure whose chest shows a glowing battery level indicator, half full.
A cyan figure holds out a glowing yellow lightbulb on an open palm, offering it to a magenta figure. The magenta figure has a hand on its chin, and small turning gears glow inside its head.
A magenta figure stands at a fork where one path splits into two, shrugging with both palms up and head tilted. Both paths fade into glowing fog after a few steps.
A cyan figure strains to lift a heavy glowing box, knees bent, and reaches one hand out toward a magenta figure walking over to help.

Two figures with their BACKS to each other, walking apart toward opposite edges of the image (left figure walks left, right figure walks right), each turning the head back over the shoulder to wave goodbye. They are moving away from each other, not approaching. Between them floats a small glowing yellow clock with the hands moving forward.
At an open doorway, a cyan figure hands a small glowing yellow sun to a magenta figure who is leaving, like handing over a gift.
A figure shades its eyes with one hand, looking at a large chaotic swirl of glowing orbits and sparks.
A cyan figure points to its own ear with one hand and toward a magenta figure with the other. A glowing dotted signal arc travels from the magenta figure back to the cyan figure's ear.
A cyan figure raises one index finger in a 'wait' gesture toward a magenta figure who has stopped mid-step. A small glowing hourglass beside them has a single grain of sand falling.

A magenta figure is frozen between two glowing doors, one hand reaching toward each, unable to choose. A cyan figure stands nearby with arms crossed, tapping one foot impatiently. No cosmetics or makeup.

Two figures stand far apart on opposite sides of the image, separated by glowing wavy lines like an ocean. A single continuous luminous thread runs from one figure's hand to the other's, connecting them.

At a counter, a cyan figure leans slightly forward with a polite small bow, pointing at one glowing icon (a coffee cup) on a board of simple icons. A magenta figure behind the counter listens attentively.
Two figures walk side by side along a straight glowing road. One raises a finger mid-step as a small side path branches off the road toward a small glowing object.

meaning_pt: Não tenha pressa / Leve o tempo que precisar.
scene: A magenta figure sits relaxed holding a steaming cup. A cyan figure stands beside it with a calm downward palm gesture. A small glowing snail crawls slowly around the edge of a large clock.
A magenta figure looks apologetic next to a small spilled cup, with a little storm cloud above its head. A cyan figure waves a hand casually, and the storm cloud is dissolving into sparkles.

A figure with a hand on its chin walks around a circular glowing track worn by many laps of footprints. A spiral thought trail rises from its head and ends in a small lightbulb that is just starting to glow.
A cyan figure speaks, and a glowing puzzle piece floats from its mouth into a matching gap in the magenta figure's head, clicking into place with a burst of light. The magenta figure nods.
